snippet.title: Sonic Breaking Point - SAGE 2025 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-breaking-point.2626/
Because Youtube doens't like me not giving away my privacy, you'll have to copy the text above URL instead of clicking it. I apologize for the inconvenience.

Sonic Breaking Point is a 2D single-player focused fighting game inspired by Flash animations such as Super Mario Bros. Z. Currently Sonic, Tails and Shadow are available to fight on 8 stages from Sonic's history. Along with its original music, the game includes a selection of iconic songs from the franchise.

The demo offers a limited selection of modes. Versus lets you duke it out with a CPU or a player locally. In Practice you can try out combos and learn each fighter's unique quirks. Tutorial will teach you all of the basic game mechanics. Watch pits CPUs against each other, letting you observe and learn strategies you may not have thought of, or just enjoy a stress-free match.
